title: Native exceptional forgetting comparison data
statement: Fix a finite field datum $D=(k_0,k,p,a)$ with $k$ an algebraic closure of $k_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a normalized realization family $R$ [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization]. A model space $T_0$ is an object of $\operatorname{Over}(\operatorname{Spec}k_0)$ with separated, quasi-compact, locally finite-type structure map. Its geometric space is $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, and its native category $\mathcal W(T_0)$ is the actual bounded constructible derived category of native Weil sheaves [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Write $C_T$ for the common-stage constructible category and $\rho_T$ for its normalized section-module realization. Define $U_T$ as native derived forgetting followed by right-derived direct image along the canonical algebraic-closure-change isomorphism and the exact section-module presentation. A ForgetModel is a functor $V_T:\mathcal W(T_0)\to C_T$ with a natural isomorphism $V_T\rho_T\simeq U_T$. For a separated finite-type model morphism $f_0$, native compact support is $F^W_f$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. A coefficient System and a geometric compactification provide the specified ordinary adjunction $F_f\dashv G_f$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Given $F^W_f\dashv G^W_f$, a Comparison is a pair of natural isomorphisms $F^W_f V_Y\simeq V_X F_f$, $G^W_f V_X\simeq V_Y G_f$ satisfying the explicit unit and counit mate equations. The model point is $s_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$; its native constant has the regular native coefficient module in degree zero with canonical Frobenius, and coefficientUnit is the ordinary sectionwise regular module in degree zero. Write $\Omega_T$ for the common-stage coefficient unit and unitRealization for $R_T[0]\simeq\rho_T(\Omega_T)$. The second pullback projection pointGeometricIso identifies the geometric fiber of $s_0$ with literal $\operatorname{Spec}k$. StructuralSystem is the same ordinary exceptional system for the literal geometric structure map. A Package consists of simultaneous ForgetModels, Comparisons for all displayed morphisms and native adjunctions, the native and common-stage point-unit identifications with their normalization equation, and the structural specialization obtained by evaluating the right comparison at the native constant, including its displayed composite formula and its literal-geometric-point version. All functors and morphisms are those of the actual derived categories, including extension morphisms. These are the existing native exceptional forgetting data, relocated verbatim.
